$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for AgroSmart. See CLAUDE.md for why each is here.
Secrets come from the environment, never from this file — it is committed.
Set SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN and SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF in your shell before starting.
The supabase server runs --read-only: schema inspection and log reading are the
daily need, while migrations go through `supabase db push` so they stay in version
control. Remove the flag deliberately, not by habit.
